spans.s:
वम् (टु-उ) वमति 1.
a. To vomit.

वम (मः-मी) 1.
m. f. Vomiting.

वाम (मः-मा-मं)
a. Left (hand); re-
verse; pleasing; vile; short.
crooked.
m. Shiva, Kāma; udder;
animal.
n. Wealth.
f. A woman,
Gauri, &c.
f. मी A mare; she-
ass; female elephant or jackal.

वमथ (थुः) 2.
m. Idem.

वामन (नः-ना-नं)
a. Short, dwarf-
ish.
m. Viṣṇu in his 5th incar-
nation; elephant of the south; a
tree, Alangium.
f. Female dwarf.

वमि (मिः) 2.
f. Vomiting.
m. Fire; a rogue.

वामी (मी) 3.
f. An elephant.

वमित (तः-ता-तं)
p. Made to vomit.

वमिन् (मी-मिनी-मि)
a. Vomiting.

वम्री (म्री) 3.
f. A small ant burrow-
ing in trees.

वम्री-कूट (टं) 1.
n. An ant-hill, a hillock.

वामता (ता) 1.
f. Contraiety; craf-
tiness; loveliness.

वाम-देव (वः) 1.
m. A name of
Shiva.

वामनक (कः-का-कं)
a. Idem.

वामनी-कृत (तः-ता-तं)
a. Shortened.

वाम-लूर (रः) 1.
m. An ant hill.

वाम-लोचन (नः-ना-नं)
a. Handsome.

वामा_क्षी (क्षी) 3.
f. A handsome
woman.

वामा_चार (रः) 1.
m. Left hand sys-
tem; using flesh, spirits, &c.

वामा_चारिन् (री) 1.
m. One follow-
ing that system.

वामापीडन (नः) 1.
m. A tree (Sal-
vadora Persica).

वामा_वर्त्त (र्त्तः) 1.
m. A shell with the
spiral turn running from right
to left.

वामिल (लः-ला-लं)
a. Proud; handsome.
